description: This file defines the Upload controller class within the Opencart admin tool namespace. It manages the upload, listing, downloading, and deletion of files, handling HTTP requests, interfacing with models, and rendering views for the upload functionality in the admin panel.

classes.name: Upload
classes.description: Controller class responsible for handling file uploads in the admin panel, including listing uploaded files, providing download links, and deleting files.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main entry point that loads the upload view with necessary data, including breadcrumbs, links, and page layout components.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handles AJAX request to retrieve the list of uploaded files and outputs it.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Generates and returns the HTML content for the list of uploaded files, including filtering, pagination, and download links.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes selected upload files after permission validation, and returns JSON response indicating success or error.

methods.name: download
methods.description: Serves a file for download based on a provided code, or shows an error page if not found.

methods.name: upload
methods.description: Handles file upload POST requests, validating permissions and file properties, then saves and registers the upload, returning a JSON response.
